More about this app
A parent or guardian creates a pairing code on the FamilySafe website (Add device). Sit together and type it in here. The code works once and expires after 10 minutes.
Pairing code
XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX
Name of this device
Your parent sees this name on the website. You can change it.
Before you connect
Your parent will see this device\'s name and details: %1$s %2$s, Android %3$s, FamilySafe version %4$s. Nothing else is shared when you connect.

Later features, like screen time or location, only start when they are turned on and you have allowed them in Android. Every feature is listed in this app. A parent can remove this device from the website at any time.
Connect this device
The code should have 16 letters and numbers, like XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Check it and try again.
Please give this device a name.
That code did not work. It may have expired or already been used. Ask your parent or guardian to create a new one.
Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
Could not reach FamilySafe. Check your internet connection and try again.
The connection was lost while connecting, so it is not clear whether it worked. Ask your parent or guardian to create a new code.
Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
This version of the app could not connect. Check for an update, or ask your parent or guardian for help.
The code was accepted, but this device could not save the connection safely.
This device could not open its secure storage. Restart the app or the phone and try again.
This device is already connected.
Connecting is already in progress.
If your parent sees this device on the website but it does not work here, they should remove it there and add it again with a new code.
Connected
This device is connected to a parent or guardian account. They can see this device\'s name and details. Nothing else is shared yet. When a feature starts, this app tells you first.
To disconnect this device, ask your parent or guardian to remove it on the FamilySafe website.
Disconnected
This device is no longer connected to a parent or guardian account. It was removed on the website, or its connection was replaced. Nothing is being shared.
This device was offline for too long, so its connection ran out. Nothing is being shared.
The connection was lost while it was being renewed, so it is not clear whether it still works. To be safe, this device disconnected itself. Nothing is being shared.
To connect again, ask your parent or guardian to remove this device on the FamilySafe website and add it again with a new code.

Exact location
Exact instead of approximate location. Only used after location is turned on.
Text messages
Not used. FamilySafe does not read your messages.
Call history
Not used. FamilySafe does not read your call history.
Not requested
FamilySafe has not asked for this.
Location
Lets a parent see where the device is, only after you and your parent turn location on.
Location in the background
Needed only for location history and safe-place alerts, and only if those are turned on. Android asks separately.
Camera
Used to scan the pairing code, and for photos you choose to send. Android shows an indicator whenever the camera is in use.
Microphone
Only for voice messages or emergency calls that you start yourself. Android shows an indicator whenever it is in use.
Screen time (usage access)
Lets FamilySafe count time spent in apps so screen-time limits can work. You turn this on in Android settings.
Installed apps
Lets a parent see which apps are on this device so they can set limits per app.
Emergency contacts
You choose which contacts to share with the contact picker. FamilySafe cannot read your other contacts.
Notifications
Lets FamilySafe tell you about limits and changes on this device.
Nothing has been synced because this device is not enrolled yet.
This device is connected. About every 15 minutes, while it has a network connection, it tells your parent\'s dashboard that it is online.

Each check-in contains only: the battery level, whether the device is charging, the kind of network it is on (for example Wi-Fi or mobile data), and the versions of this app and of Android. Nothing else is sent by this feature.
About every 6 hours, and when you open this app, FamilySafe also tells your parent whether each permission on the Permissions screen is on or off. Nothing else is sent by this feature.
Last sync: %1$s

These are things FamilySafe will never do.
It never hides its icon or its name, and it shows up in your app list.
It does not read your messages, emails or chats, and it does not record your screen.
It never turns on the microphone or camera by itself.
A parent removes a device from the website. If something feels wrong, talk to your parent or guardian, or another adult you trust.
Version %1$s
FamilySafe is a family safety app. It is built to be open about what it does: every feature is listed in this app, and Android asks before it is used.
Location, app usage and similar data are only collected when a feature is turned on and you have granted the matching Android permission.
Screen time shared with your parent

When you turn on Usage Access in Android settings, this device sends, about every 6 hours and when you open this app, how long the screen was on, how many times it was unlocked and how long each app was open today. Only the app\'s technical package name is sent. Nothing you type, see, say or send inside apps is included, and neither are websites, messages or photos.

Turn on Usage Access
Screen-time features need Android\'s Usage Access. It lets FamilySafe see how long apps were open. It does not show what happens inside an app.
1. Tap the button below. 2. Choose FamilySafe in the list. 3. Turn on "Allow usage access". You can turn it off again at any time; FamilySafe stops reading usage as soon as you do.
